evidence.quote: Bank of America Research sees the server CPU total addressable market reaching $170 billion by 2030, roughly four times current levels
evidence.one_line: BofA Research (Vivek Arya) projects server CPU TAM reaching $170bn by 2030, about four times current levels.
evidence.speaker: Bank of America Research

evidence.quote: BofA maintains a Buy rating and $350 price target on NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA)
evidence.one_line: BofA maintains Buy rating and $350 price target on NVIDIA.
evidence.speaker: Bank of America Research

evidence.quote: NVIDIA's Vera CPU is built around the former view: it combines 88 custom Olympus ARM-based cores, 1.2TB/s memory bandwidth, and 3.4TB/s on-die fabric bandwidth
evidence.one_line: NVIDIA Vera CPU specs: 88 custom Olympus ARM cores, 1.2TB/s memory bandwidth, 3.4TB/s on-die fabric bandwidth.
evidence.speaker: Bank of America Research

evidence.quote: BofA notes that AMD estimates its EPYC 9965 (Turin) chip delivers approximately 2.4x the rack-level throughput of NVIDIA's Vera baseline in a modeled 100kW deployment, with the next-generation EPYC 6 (Venice) projected to extend that advantage to roughly 3.3x total throughput
evidence.one_line: AMD estimates EPYC 9965 delivers about 2.4x rack-level throughput vs NVIDIA Vera baseline; Venice projected about 3.3x.
evidence.speaker: AMD (as characterized by BofA)

evidence.quote: Our expectation is that AMD's Thursday event will be less about benchmark comparisons and more about establishing the industry's preferred metric,
evidence.one_line: BofA expects AMD's Thursday AI 2026 Day to focus on establishing preferred metrics rather than benchmarks.
evidence.speaker: Vivek Arya

candidates.question: Will NVIDIA report data center CPU or Vera-related revenue for FY2027 at or above the threshold?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: Vera CPU revenue at or above 10 billion USD

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: Vera CPU revenue from 5 to below 10 billion USD

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: Vera CPU revenue from 1 to below 5 billion USD

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: Vera CPU revenue from 0 to below 1 billion USD

candidates.settled_by: NVIDIA FY2027 annual report revenue disclosure by product
